description: Issuer data for an issued asset: flags, domain, transfer fee and total issued. When to use: Before accepting or sending an issued token: check that the issuer exists, is not frozen, whether holders need authorization, and the transfer fee charged on every transfer between non-issuer accounts. Prefer another tool: For XRP (not an issued asset; 400), for one account's own balances use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`, and for prices use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook` or `/v1/xrpl/amm/{a}/{b}`. Example: xrpl_token {"asset":"USD.rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"}

asset.description: Issued asset, never XRP. Currency format: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

name: xrpl_token

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amm_id.description: `AMMID`: set only on that pseudo-account; else null

asset.description: Token queried, in the canonical form the route reads: `CODE.issuer` (echo of the path `asset`); its readable text is `currency_ascii`

blackholed.description: True when the master key is disabled, there is no signer list and no usable regular key, so the account can never sign again

currency.description: Canonical currency code (3 characters or 40 hex)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

domain.description: Issuer domain decoded to text, when set

flags.description: AccountRoot flags of the account decoded to booleans

allow_trustline_locking.description: lsfAllowTrustLineLocking: the issuer lets holders' trust lines be locked by escrow

disable_master.description: lsfDisableMaster: the master key is disabled

disallow_incoming.description: Incoming checks, NFToken offers, payment channels and trust lines the account blocks

frozen_obligations.description: Sum of this currency's `frozen_balances` in `gateway_balances` (frozen lines, outside `obligations`), in units of `currency`; "0" when none; null when `obligations_status` is `unavailable`

loan_broker_id.description: `LoanBrokerID`: set only on that pseudo-account; else null

locked_obligations.description: This currency's `locked` amount in `gateway_balances` (held in escrow), in units of `currency`; "0" when none; null when `obligations_status` is `unavailable`

obligations.description: Total issued of this currency, in units of `currency` (its `obligations` entry in `gateway_balances`); "0" when none; null when `obligations_status` is `unavailable`

tick_size.description: The issuer's `TickSize` (3 to 15 significant digits in offer exchange rates), null when unset

transfer_fee_pct.description: Issuer transfer fee in percent: (TransferRate - 1000000000) / 10000000, exact; "0" when the issuer sets none

vault_id.description: `VaultID`: set only on that pseudo-account; else null

title: Token issuer
